notes: BMCIlluminatiPass is the accepted block-derived Mystery design, not the deterministic development branch. Constructor (initialOwner, bmcToken): the explicit owner and the existing Ethereum Mainnet BMC ERC-20 address; the BMC address is not an NFT deployment address, and the constructor makes no external calls. StandardArt is an internal, inlined library and needs no separate deployment or linking. The collection has 500 NFTs: sequential Genesis IDs 1-40 cost 1,000,000 BMC each, followed by 460 Mystery mints costing 350,000 BMC each with 37 Genesis and 423 Standard outcomes drawn without replacement. Each mint calls BMC burnFrom and verifies exact payer balance and total supply reductions; the contract never transfers BMC to any wallet. Genesis metadata uses the fixed supplied IPFS CID and genesis-01.png through genesis-77.png; Standard SVG artwork is on-chain. Launch gate: on chain id 1 the contract deploys closed. mintingOpen is false and both mint functions revert MintingNotOpen until the owner ($owner) calls openMinting() once; that call is one-way, there is no close, pause, restrict, price, metadata, special-mint, withdrawal or upgrade power, and the open state survives renounceOwnership. On other chain ids the contract is open from construction for rehearsals. Mystery mints burn and record the mint block; outcomes are settled later, in mint order, by the permissionless reveal(maxCount) call from the hash of the block after the mint block, so no caller can observe or revert its own outcome within the mint transaction. The reveal hash is readable natively for 256 blocks and through the EIP-2935 history contract (0x0000F90827F1C53a10cb7A02335B175320002935, present on Mainnet since Prague) for 8,191 blocks; a pass not revealed in that window settles as Standard, so delaying a reveal cannot improve it. Block-derived randomness remains manipulable: the proposer of the reveal block can bias or withhold it and builders influence ordering, so unique inventory does not guarantee fair allocation and the website must not advertise tamper-proof randomness. This manifest neither deploys contracts nor authorizes public minting. Keep the website in PRE_LAUNCH with no approval or mint transactions until the finalized source revision and actual Mainnet NFT address/ABI are confirmed, deployed bytecode matches the reviewed build, security findings are addressed, deployed minting/burning is validated on a fork, and explicit public-mint authorization is recorded; only then does the owner send openMinting(). No post-deployment initialization, funding, token deployment or pool is required.
